fields.body_md:
## At a glance

Concordia University is in Montreal, Quebec. This page uses its **Master of Applied Computer Science** to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is the price per credit. Concordia charges international students **CAD 795** a credit for the 2026-27 cohort. The 45 credits add up to **CAD 35,775** (**₹23.35 lakh**), plus compulsory fees.

| | Master of Applied Computer Science |
|---|---|
| Campus | Montreal |
| Length | 1 to 2 years, 45 credits |
| Co-op | Optional, paid |
| Intakes | Fall, winter and summer |
| Tuition, 45 credits (2026-27 cohort) | **CAD 35,775** |
| Minimum GPA | **3.00** on a scale of 4.30 |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall |
| Fall deadline for international students | **1 March** |

Concordia is a designated learning institution. IRCC's list shows it as a public institution. Its DLI number is O19359011007. Concordia is in Quebec, so you also need a CAQ.

## What it really costs

The study permit asks you to show enough money for tuition, living costs and travel. Read the [proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-proof-of-funds-guide) for the rules.

Tuition for 45 credits is **CAD 35,775** (**₹23.35 lakh**) at the 2026-27 rate. Concordia's page does not list compulsory fees, so we give no total. For Quebec, the living amount for one student is **CAD 24,617** (**₹16.07 lakh**) per year, plus your flights. Montreal rents are in our [cost of living guide](/study-abroad/study-in/canada/canada-cost-of-living).

Rupee amounts use **₹65.27 per Canadian dollar**, the Bank of Canada rate for 27 November 2026. Rates move every day and your bank will charge its own rate, so treat the rupee figures as a guide.

## Getting in

Concordia asks for a computer science degree and high standing. It says this means honours, or a GPA of at least **3.00 on a scale of 4.30**. See the [programme page](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/concordia-university/concordia-master-of-applied-computer-science) for the details.

## Deadlines

International deadlines are **1 March** for Fall, **1 July** for Winter and **1 November** for Summer. Concordia lists no year, so check the page. For most readers the next one is **1 March 2027**.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Applied Computer Science](/study-abroad/program-detail/canada/concordia-university/concordia-master-of-applied-computer-science): 45 credits, CAD 795 a credit for the 2026-27 cohort.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if** you hold a computer science degree and want a per-credit rate that is fixed for your programme.

**Think carefully if** you need a full cost. Compulsory fees are extra and were not listed.

## Sources

- [Concordia graduate tuition and fee rates](https://www.concordia.ca/students/financial/tuition-fees/rates/grad.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Concordia graduate admissions calendar](https://www.concordia.ca/academics/graduate/calendar/current/admissions.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Concordia English language proficiency](https://www.concordia.ca/gradstudies/future-students/how-to-apply/english-language-proficiency.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Quebec government: financial resources for international students](https://www.quebec.ca/en/education/study-quebec/required-conditions/costs-studies). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [IRCC designated learning institutions list](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/prepare/designated-learning-institutions-list.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Bank of Canada exchange rates](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/exchange/daily-exchange-rates/). Checked on 28 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the Concordia Master of Applied Computer Science cost?
faq_json.a: Concordia charges international students CAD 795 per credit for the 2026-27 cohort. For 45 credits that is CAD 35,775, about ₹23.35 lakh at ₹65.27 per Canadian dollar. Compulsory fees are extra.

faq_json.q: Is Concordia's tuition fixed for the whole programme?
faq_json.a: Concordia says the rate for international students in course-based master's programmes is fixed for the length of the programme, for your cohort year. The 2027-28 rate was not posted.

faq_json.q: What is the Concordia deadline for Fall 2027?
faq_json.a: Concordia lists 1 March for Fall for international students. The next Fall start is in 2027, so apply by 1 March 2027. Check the page for the year.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does Concordia need for computer science?
faq_json.a: For the Gina Cody School, IELTS 6.5 overall with no English courses. An IELTS of 6.0 with no part under 5.5 needs extra English courses. Below 6.0 means no admission.
